items: Check whether NetworkManager reports the intended device connected.
Check whether the problem affects all applications or only a managed application.
Review the configured VPN/tunnel status without changing routing.
For NFS, inspect Sharing Status and role enablement.
For pending external enrollment, complete only the user-approved account workflow.

blocks.text: Keep the exact time and sanitized error. Use the owning connection utility to reconnect when intended. If DNS or a remote service is unavailable, changing firewall tables blindly will not establish the cause.
Do not publish raw connection profiles, packet captures or credentials. Do not flush rules, reset NetworkManager state or change namespace interfaces to make a diagnostic pass.
